backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining Task, TaskContent, AdsMetrics, and Milestone types with CRUD operations for tasks, milestones, and ads metrics; includes methods for task management, milestone progress updates, and ads data tracking across 6 phases and 18 milestones.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting five high-confidence features related to fixing milestone progress slider functionality: mutation parameter passing, slider onChange handler, comprehensive logging, cache invalidation, and error handling improvements.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of 19 frontend files describing the React application structure with TanStack Router, task/milestone management UI, manual progress sliders, phase-based navigation, and comprehensive logging for debugging slider interactions.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark theme variables including six phase-specific colors (phase-1 through phase-6) and comprehensive UI component color tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with Spanish title 'Dashboard de Plan de 90 Días' and root div mounting point.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with two routes (Dashboard at '/' and AdsDashboard at '/ads'), wrapped with QueryClientProvider, ThemeProvider, and Toaster for global state and notifications.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component with header showing app title and navigation tabs between main dashboard and ADS dashboard, plus footer with caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/MilestoneSection: Expandable milestone card component with manual progress slider that calls updateMilestoneProgressMutation; includes comprehensive logging, error handling with toast notifications, and automatic reversion on failure.
Displays a card showing overall project progress with a percentage, progress bar, and count of completed milestones out of total milestones.
Renders a grid of clickable phase cards showing phase title, date range, progress bar, and completion status with badges.
frontend/src/components/ProgressIndicato: Simple badge component that displays either a completed status with checkmark or pending status with circle icon.
frontend/src/components/TaskCard.tsx: Displays a task card with description, due date, day number, edit button, and an internal notes textarea that auto-saves on blur.
frontend/src/components/TaskDialog.tsx: Dialog wrapper component that renders a TaskForm for either creating a new task or editing an existing one.
frontend/src/components/TaskForm.tsx: Form component for creating or editing tasks with phase/milestone selects, description input, and due date picker; handles cascading milestone filtering based on selected phase.
frontend/src/constants/milestones.ts: Defines the complete 6-phase, 18-milestone flight plan structure with detailed milestone data including titles, day ranges, date ranges, and content descriptions for a 90-day legal services business launch plan.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that creates and manages the ICP backend actor, handling both authenticated and anonymous actors, and invalidates dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdsMetrics.ts: React Query hook for fetching all ads metrics and providing a mutation to add new ads metrics (month, spent, leads, appointments, converted).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality, identity state management, and configurable AuthClient options for ICP authentication.
frontend/src/hooks/useTasks.ts: React Query hook for managing tasks and milestones, including fetching all tasks/milestones, adding/editing/deleting tasks, toggling task completion, and auto-initializing 18 milestones from constants if backend is empty.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables defining a warm earth-tones color palette (avoiding blue/purple), including light/dark mode themes, phase-specific colors, and chart colors using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/pages/AdsDashboard.tsx: Dashboard page for tracking monthly advertising metrics (spend, leads, appointments, conversions) with a form to add new metrics and a table displaying calculated KPIs like cost-per-lead and conversion rates.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying the 90-day flight plan with phase navigation, overall progress, milestone sections, and task management dialog for a lead generation system.
frontend/src/utils/adsCalculations.ts: Utility functions for calculating advertising metrics (cost per lead, appointment rate, conversion rate, cost per conversion) and formatting currency/percentage values.
frontend/src/utils/dateUtils.ts: Date utility functions for converting between JavaScript Date and backend Time (nanoseconds), calculating day numbers within a fixed 90-day period starting February 20, 2026, and formatting dates in Spanish locale.
frontend/src/utils/progressUtils.ts: Utility functions for calculating phase and overall progress based on milestone completion percentages, returning structured progress data with completed counts and average percentages.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom colors using OKLCH color space (including phase and chart colors), container settings, border radius variables, and custom animations for accordions.
project_state.json: Project state tracking for a 90-day Spanish-language dashboard for a Utah personal injury lead generation system, structured in 6 phases with 18 milestones. Documents multiple known issues with checkbox/slider functionality not working properly across versions 3-10, particularly progress tracking features being non-functional.
